name: WebSocket-based web server and PM2 alternative

mentions.name: WebSocket-based web server and PM2 alternative
mentions.description: A personal web server that serves HTTP over WebSockets for increased speed and durability, with built-in proxies and redirections configured through small JSON rules, running on Linux and Windows. It has evolved into a PM2-style alternative for remote machine health monitoring and interaction, featuring a built-in terminal emulator and a browser-based dashboard written entirely in TypeScript. Planned additions include peer-to-peer data sharing so the dashboard can display data from multiple machines, plus event-oriented reporting of USB devices, processes, services, and users to alert on changes in real time.
mentions.problem: Wanted remote monitoring of machine health and interaction.
